calls.title: Microfoundations of International Business: Integrating Insights from Human Resource Management and Organizational Behavior
calls.summary: Special issue of Journal of International Business Studies seeking conceptual, empirical, multilevel, and mixed-method papers connecting micro-level HRM/OB phenomena (behavior, cognition, emotion, decision-making) with macro-level international business outcomes. Supervising editors Herman Aguinis and Pawan Budhwar.

calls.title: AI, Data, and Multinational Enterprises in a Multipolar World
calls.summary: Special issue examining whether and how AI and data reshape MNE strategy, structure, operations, and governance across countries and cultures in a fragmented, multipolar world. Submission window is September 15-30, 2027; guest editor names were not visible in available search snippets.

calls.title: The Dark Sides of Digital Communication
calls.summary: JMS special issue call examining the negative/dark-side effects of digital communication technologies on organizations and individuals; submission deadline 30 September 2026, with a post-submission paper development workshop planned at the Academy of Management Conference 2026 in Philadelphia.

calls.title: Organizational Practices for Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion in Institutionally Contested Times
calls.summary: JMS special issue on organizational EDI practices amid institutionally contested times; includes a virtual pre-submission information session on 1 October 2026 and a submission window of 15-31 March 2027, with a post-submission PDW at University of Palermo in October 2027. Guest editor names were not found in available sources.

calls.title: Board Dynamics in Complex Times
calls.summary: Special issue of Journal of Management Studies inviting research on behavioral, cognitive, and relational dynamics of corporate boards, including board decision-making, power dynamics, and board interfaces with internal/external actors.

calls.title: Organizing Truth in an Age of Polarization and Artificial Intelligence
calls.summary: JMS special issue seeking theoretically grounded research on how truth is perceived, contested, and made consequential in and around organizations amid polarization and AI; builds on the JMS 2026 conference in Cambridge. Submission deadline 3 May 2027. Guest editor names were not found in available sources.

calls.title: Special Call: Qualitative Research Proposals
calls.summary: Recurring Journal of Management special call (not a standard special issue) inviting short proposals for creative/innovative qualitative research; the next submission window is January 1-15, 2027 (11:59pm EST), with authors advised whether proposals are accepted for development by March 15, 2027. Accepted full papers are published online/in print on a rolling basis with a note indicating participation in this Special Call. Editor-in-Chief is Cindy Devers.

calls.title: AI-Enabled Frontiers in Organizational Science
calls.summary: Special issue asking whether AI should produce faster/cheaper versions of existing research or fundamentally new science; seeks AI-enabled research loops, reusable research infrastructure, new measurement, and synthetic social systems via a three-stage proposal-workshop-finalization process. Submission window is October 1 - November 1, 2026.

calls.title: AI and Social Science
calls.summary: Organization Science special issue soliciting AI-enabled research loops, reusable research infrastructure, and other fundamentally new forms of social science, run as a three-stage process (proposal/prototype, workshop, finalization) with short Science/Nature-style articles.

calls.title: Agency in the Age of AI
calls.summary: Special issue inviting theoretically ambitious, conceptual or empirical work on how agency changes as organizational action is increasingly co-produced by people and AI agents; the journal will use an accelerated review process. Submissions are due February 1, 2027.

calls.title: Qualitative Restudies: Retheorizing in a Changing World
calls.summary: Special issue call for Organization Studies inviting qualitative 'restudies' of established theories or empirical sites to retheorize organizational phenomena; listed on SAGE's Organization Studies calls-for-papers page.

calls.title: Advancing Systems Perspectives in Organization Studies to Address Social-Ecological Challenges
calls.summary: Special issue call for Organization Studies on applying systems thinking to social-ecological challenges facing organizations; listed on SAGE's Organization Studies calls-for-papers page.

calls.title: The Architecture of Hope in Distressing Times and Places: Construction, Action, and Possibilities
guest_editors: Bryant A. Hudson (IESEG School of Management)
Madeline Toubiana (Telfer School of Management, University of Ottawa)
calls.summary: Special issue call for Organization Studies on hope in organizations facing distressing, turbulent circumstances; connected to a related 20th OS Summer Workshop; submission window is 15-30 January 2027.

calls.title: Emotions, Values and Institutions in Turbulent Times
calls.summary: Special issue call for Organization Studies examining how emotions and values shape institutions amid turbulence; listed as a currently open call on SAGE's Organization Studies calls-for-papers page.

calls.title: Embodying Processes
calls.summary: Special issue call for Organization Studies on embodying processes; submission window runs 15-30 September 2026, with the final deadline falling just after the report date.

calls.title: The Coevolution of Financial and Technological Innovations
calls.summary: Research Policy special issue examining the interactions and coevolution between financial innovation and technological innovation, providing a forum for interdisciplinary research; submission deadline 30 November 2026.

calls.title: Measuring and Enhancing the Societal Impact of Academic Engagement
calls.summary: Research Policy special issue analysing how the societal impact of academic engagement can be measured and enhanced.

calls.title: China's Innovation and Technology Policy
calls.summary: Research Policy special issue on the evolution, institutions, and trajectory of China's innovation and technology policy; guest edited by a team including Xiaolan Fu and Arie Lewin. Submission deadline 1 June 2027.

calls.title: Entrepreneurial Ecosystems in Contexts of Institutional Uncertainty, Resource Constraints, and Heightened Volatility
calls.deadline_text: Deadline not independently confirmed; aggregated secondary sources place SEJ special-issue deadlines on the SMS call-for-papers hub around April 2027
calls.summary: SEJ special issue seeking to advance understanding of how entrepreneurial ecosystems emerge, evolve, and operate in emerging economies and other non-advanced contexts marked by institutional uncertainty, resource constraints, and heightened volatility (broadening EE research beyond mature, advanced-economy ecosystems). SEJ Supervising Co-Editor: Peter Klein, Baylor University.

calls.title: The Strategic Role of Judgment in Entrepreneurial Ecosystems
calls.summary: SEJ special issue on how judgment is mobilized, organized, and exploited within entrepreneurial ecosystems, including governance mechanisms for cooperation, competition, resource allocation, and innovation.

calls.title: Entrepreneurial Judgment Under Knightian Uncertainty in Ecosystems
calls.summary: Special issue of Strategic Entrepreneurship Journal on how entrepreneurial judgment under Knightian uncertainty is mobilized, communicated, and governed within entrepreneurial ecosystems (interfirm collaborations, alliances, digital ecosystems), moving beyond single-firm perspectives; full paper submission deadline is March 1, 2027.

calls.title: Entrepreneurial Judgment in Ecosystems
calls.summary: SEJ special issue on how entrepreneurial judgment under uncertainty is mobilized, communicated, coordinated, and governed across multiple stakeholders within entrepreneurial ecosystems, moving beyond single-firm/individual-decision-maker framings. Deadline for full paper submissions is March 1, 2027.

calls.title: International Entrepreneurship in an Age of Persistent Disruption
calls.summary: Special issue of Strategic Entrepreneurship Journal inviting research on international entrepreneurship amid persistent global disruption; a paper development workshop for revise-and-resubmit manuscripts is planned online with dates TBA. SEJ Supervising Co-Editor is Yong Li (University of Nevada, Las Vegas). Submission deadline March 31, 2027.

calls.title: Building a Science of the Particular: Methods for Strategy's Core Questions
calls.summary: Special issue of Strategy Science seeking paper proposals on how strategy research can better address particular, firm-specific problems and situations, with Todd Zenger serving as advisor.

calls.title: Building a Science of the Particular: Methods for Strategy
calls.deadline_text: proposals due December 15, 2026; strongest proposals invited as full paper submissions due April 15, 2027
calls.summary: Strategy Science special issue call for paper proposals on methods for strategy research, advised by Todd Zenger, run as a proposal stage followed by an author workshop and full peer review.
